P1_same_instant_clustering.measures: share of fills sharing (timestamp, side, price) with another fill -- one aggressor consuming one resting level
P1_same_instant_clustering.H1: LOW: one decision produces one order
P1_same_instant_clustering.H3: HIGH: a resting level is swept in pieces

P2_price_walk_within_a_run.measures: share of consecutive same-side fills at an IDENTICAL price
P2_price_walk_within_a_run.H3: HIGH: the same resting level keeps trading

P3_bought_the_falling_side.measures: P(the side bought is the side whose price FELL over the preceding 60s), fills at flat price excluded
P3_bought_the_falling_side.H1: ~0.5 unless a directional rule exists, and none is supported
P3_bought_the_falling_side.H3: ABOVE 0.5: a resting bid is hit by sellers pushing that side down

P4_run_continuation_hazard.measures: P(next fill is the same side | current run length k), OOS
P4_run_continuation_hazard.H1: state-dependent, not monotone in k alone
P4_run_continuation_hazard.H2: FALLS with k: the target pulls back
P4_run_continuation_hazard.H3: RISES with k: order flow is persistent

P5_error_correction_to_a_target.measures: mean change in residual over the next 5 fills, by current residual bucket
P5_error_correction_to_a_target.H2: STRONG NEGATIVE SLOPE and stable OOS: deviation is corrected
P5_error_correction_to_a_target.H3: WEAK: a passive surface has no target to correct toward

P6_state_beats_persistence.measures: OOS log-loss of P(next side) from a state-conditional table vs a previous-side-only baseline
P6_state_beats_persistence.H1: IMPROVES materially: state carries the decision

P7_matched_yield_rises_with_volatility.measures: fraction of shares acquired in a |dp| bin that end the window MATCHED
P7_matched_yield_rises_with_volatility.H4: RISES with |dp|: movement brings the complement

P8_timing_depends_on_inventory_or_on_flo.measures: spread of median inter-fill seconds across OUR residual buckets vs across market |dp| buckets
P8_timing_depends_on_inventory_or_on_flo.H1: inventory matters: a decider waits differently by position
P8_timing_depends_on_inventory_or_on_flo.H3: FLOW matters and INVENTORY DOES NOT: a resting quote does not know our position

untestable_here: whether L5 was quoting both sides at once -- unfilled orders leave no trace, so a two-sided surface and a one-sided one are indistinguishable except through their consequences, which is what P1/P2/P3/P8 measure
queue position, depth, spread, or any book quantity
whether a fill was maker or taker (only fee-bearing vs fee-free)

P2_price_walk_within_a_run.specification_limit: tests a SINGLE-level resting quote. A multi-level surface -- which H3 explicitly permits -- predicts exactly this walk, so a CONTRADICTS here does not falsify H3, only its single-level form.

P8_timing_depends_on_inventory_or_flow.resolution_note: UNINFORMATIVE AT THIS RESOLUTION: the tape timestamps whole seconds and the median inter-fill gap is 1 s, so every bucket collapses onto 1-2 s. Separating inventory-driven from flow-driven timing needs sub-second stamps this dataset does not carry. Report as undecided, not as support.

P8_timing_depends_on_inventory_or_flow.resolution_note: UNINFORMATIVE AT THIS RESOLUTION: the tape timestamps whole seconds and the median inter-fill gap is 2 s, so every bucket collapses onto 1-2 s. labels: Scored OUT OF SAMPLE against predictions declared before any scoring code existed. No winner is forced: a hypothesis may end contradicted, and a test that separates nothing reports NEUTRAL rather than being dropped. TRAIN is shown only to say whether a verdict held in both halves.
